encoding.description: [`PCM_S16LE`] or [`OPUS`]; another word is a format a newer host may offer.

rate.description: Samples per second per channel: 16000 is what most recognizers want.

x-enum-labels.pcm: The samples alone, 16-bit little-endian, at the rate and channels the recording opened with.
x-enum-labels.wav: A WAV stream: a header whose sizes say "until the end" and then the samples. What `ffmpeg -i -` and most command line recognizers read.

partials.description: Whether each change in its output while the person speaks is shown as it appears; off, the text comes when they stop.
partials.title: Show text while speaking

program.description: The program to run: a name found on the search path, or a path.
program.title: Program

timeout_seconds.description: How long it may take after the audio ends, in seconds, before it is stopped.
timeout_seconds.title: Time to finish

api_key.description: A key sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, when the endpoint asks for one.
api_key.title: Key

max_seconds.description: The longest recording kept, in seconds; a longer one is refused rather than held.
max_seconds.title: Longest recording

model.description: The model to ask for, when the endpoint takes one.
model.title: Model

timeout_seconds.description: How long the call may take, in seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Time to answer

url.description: The address the audio is posted to, such as `https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions`.
url.title: Address

partial.description: The whole text so far, replacing the last partial, when it changed; absent when it did not.

language.description: The language spoken, as a BCP 47 tag (`en`, `es-PR`); absent asks the provider to find out.

accent.description: How they speak the language, such as `Puerto Rican Spanish`.

traits.description: Anything else a provider may know by name; a provider ignores a key it does not know.

voice.description: The kind of voice, in their words, such as `male`, `female` or `child`.

vocabulary.description: Words and names likely to be said, which a recognizer may favour.
